changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 3 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6349-types-internal-name-collisions-batch-1.md`

- names `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts` → `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts` — edited by this change

  > The three `KNOWN_COLLISIONS` lines came down in the same change; that baseline (`scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`) is shrink-only and fails in both directions, so converging without deleting them would have been red too. 43 entries → 40.

### `.changeset/8632-malformed-picklist-option-loud.md`

- names `packages/i18n/README.md` → `packages/i18n/README.md` — edited by this change

  > Two new strings land in the designer's own `en` / `zh` tables — the metadata-admin console owns its strings in `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and is deliberately outside the ten locale packs (`packages/i18n/README.md`, "Scope — the `engine.*` carve-out").

### `.changeset/9615-locale-count-ten.md`

- names `packages/i18n/README.md` → `packages/i18n/README.md` — edited by this change

  > Correcting the numeral to ten was weighed and refused. A restated count is the construct that permitted the error, and this repository has now watched it recur three times over the same fact — objectui#3351 in a changeset file, objectui#7989 in `packages/i18n/README.md`, and this one in published source. So the number is **gone** rather than corrected: the sentence now claims only what it needs (the key is translated in every locale the package ships) and names `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` as the instrument that re-derives it. That test asserts the stronger invariant — every pack defines every `en` key — over whatever the pack set is on the day it runs, so an eleventh pack makes the sentence more true rather than false, and there is no figure left to rot (AGENTS.md commandment #9).

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `c61099087` (merge-base with origin/main): 10 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1538 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2123 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36183053778)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `367e586e4e70ea08bd53336440f390f901955b79`

### ① Derived judgments

- **One authority — for exported names yes; for the name, no.** `git grep` over `packages/*/src` at head finds two declarations of `TranslateFn`: `packages/i18n/src/translateFn.ts` (exported, the authority) and `packages/app-shell/src/utils/managedByEmptyState.ts` (`type TranslateFn = …`, unexported, untouched). At merge-base `c659439b4` there were four (exported: `writeWarningToast.ts`, `file-size-guard.ts`; unexported: `usePublishAllDrafts.ts` spelled `opts`, `managedByEmptyState.ts`). Every exported site is now `export type { TranslateFn } from '@object-ui/i18n'` (writeWarningToast, saveAdvisoryToast, metadataReadWarningToast, file-size-guard); no aliasing re-export `as TranslateFn` exists anywhere in the tree.
- **Byte identity holds.** The declaration line with its newline is 86 bytes, sha256 `29f2f334f47b8ac5…`, at base in both `writeWarningToast.ts` and `file-size-guard.ts`, at `158d75bb3` in all three (incl. `saveAdvisoryToast.ts`), and at head in `packages/i18n/src/translateFn.ts`. `managedByEmptyState.ts`'s line hashes identically once `export ` is prefixed. `usePublishAllDrafts` differed only in the parameter name; parameter names are not part of a function type; the pin `usePublishAllDrafts(t: TranslateFn)` in `perm-home-namespace-3546.test.tsx` is kept.
- **Published face.** Built at head (turbo 29 tasks, 28 content-hash cache hits, `app-shell` executed): `packages/i18n/dist/index.d.ts` carries `export type { TranslateFn } from './translateFn.js'` (1; control `SafeTranslate` 1); `dist/translateFn.d.ts` carries the declaration. `fields/dist/index.d.ts` 0 (control `FileField` 2); `app-shell/dist/index.d.ts` 0 (control `AdapterProvider` 1). Published 17.6.0 tarballs (npm pack): `dist/index.d.ts` of `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/fields` each carry 0 `TranslateFn`; their `exports` maps expose only `.` plus a css subpath, so the deep `dist/providers/writeWarningToast.d.ts` and `dist/widgets/file-size-guard.d.ts` that did declare it are shipped bytes, not an addressable face. So no consumer could import `TranslateFn` from `@object-ui/app-shell` or `@object-ui/fields` before, and nothing breaks now. Root tsconfig: `isolatedModules: true`, no `verbatimModuleSyntax`; `export type { X } from` is the legal spelling under both, and every in-repo importer carries the inline `type` marker.
- **Runtime erases.** Built `app-shell/dist/providers/{writeWarningToast,saveAdvisoryToast,metadataReadWarningToast}.js` have zero import lines; `usePublishAllDrafts.js` has 6, none from `@object-ui/i18n`; a single-file isolatedModules transpile of `file-size-guard.ts` emits no import; the fields bundle's one `@object-ui/i18n` import statement names only pre-existing runtime symbols. Same as 17.6.0. Arrows: i18n depends on core, core on types; app-shell and fields on i18n; no `package.json` changed; no cycle.
- **Toast modules.** Comment-stripped diff base..head of `saveAdvisoryToast.ts` and `metadataReadWarningToast.ts` is exactly two lines each: the `import type` and `export type { … } from` specifiers, `'./writeWarningToast.js'` to `'@object-ui/i18n'`. No runtime line moved.
- **Gate re-run** in a detached worktree at head under `os-verify-lock.sh` (VERDICT command-exit 0, held 161s): 11 passed. Leg A, the declaration put back in `file-size-guard.ts` (decl 0 to 1, re-export 1 to 0, blob `ca873659` to `6e625184`): 1 failed, "`TranslateFn` — a NEW colliding name" naming `file-size-guard.ts` and `i18n/src/translateFn.ts`, then the SHRINK-ONLY refusal. Leg B, the row put back with re-points kept (rows 0 to 1, blob `600bed9b` to `49a2b024`): 1 failed, "KNOWN_COLLISIONS lists collisions that no longer exist … `TranslateFn` — no longer collides at writeWarningToast.ts, file-size-guard.ts", so the row's removal was owed. Both restores: disk blob equals the `HEAD` blob, `git status --porcelain` empty. Leg C, a probe typed `TranslateFn` but taking `key: number` in `file-size-guard.ts`: exactly one TS2322 from fields tsc, restored to the `HEAD` blob. Type-check (`tsc --noEmit` plus `tsconfig.test.json`) exit 0, zero `error TS`, for i18n, fields and app-shell.
- **Declared leftovers.** `managedByEmptyState.ts` is inside the gate's population (published package, `src/`, not a test) but invisible to it: its `DECLARATION` regex requires a leading `export`. The ruling's sentence is about the shape ("the one authority for the narrowed-`t` shape lives in `@object-ui/i18n`") and explicitly sequences the rest of the population into #8203 "once #8261 lands", so leaving it is consistent with the ruling's ordering. But #8203 was closed `not_planned` on 2026-09-24 (no carrier remains; the PR says "Carrier: none"), and the PR re-pointed the other unexported `TranslateFn` (`usePublishAllDrafts.ts`, an #8203 row) while leaving the byte-identical one. `core`'s `Translate` cannot re-point because i18n depends on core: correct.

### ② Semver level

- `'@object-ui/i18n': minor` is right: a new name on the `exports`-reachable face is Clause-② yes, at least `minor`, and `major` is refused by the fixed group (`check-changeset-no-major`; CI `Changeset Bump Policy` green). `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch` and `'@object-ui/fields': patch` are right: their addressable faces are unchanged (built `index.d.ts` 0 before and after); only shipped deep `.d.ts` bytes move. The fixed group lifts all 39 packages to the same minor regardless.
- `Clause-②: yes — @object-ui/i18n publishes a new name, TranslateFn` on the PR body's second line: correctly stated (value first after the colon; no arm is needed for a non-breaking addition), identical to the claim's line, consistent with `minor`.
- **New changeset, sentence by sentence.** Publishes-as-authority sentence: true. Snippet: compiles. "each declared their own copy … byte-identical … both modules now re-export … no call site's contract moves": true for `writeWarningToast` and `file-size-guard`; the parenthetical "(`writeWarningToast` and its sibling toast modules)" is inexact, at base both siblings re-exported (decl 0, re-export 1 each) and only `writeWarningToast` declared. "Neither package publishes the name from its own entry": true. ⛔ "the name now has one declaration": false on the tree, `managedByEmptyState.ts` declares `type TranslateFn`; the sentence ships into three CHANGELOGs.
- **README section.** First sentence true. The snippet compiles against the built `packages/i18n/dist/index.d.ts` (exit 0; a `t(42)` control gives TS2345; a control pointed at a declaration file without the export gives TS2305, so the pass is a real resolution). ⛔ "This package is the one place that type is declared": false on the tree for the same reason (and ten further declarations of the shape under other names per #8203); it ships in the tarball.
- **`.changeset/8165-translatefn-one-authority.md`.** Frontmatter lines 1–2 md5 `2ee28f1e1b449ccc2dd97fdcc6c2bc1f` at main and at head; the file is unchanged between merge-base and main. The two rewritten sentences are scoped "At this change" / "at this change"; the `⚠️ **Dated note, 2026-09-25 — … — objectui#8261.**` paragraph matches the form 28 pending changesets on main already carry. Every sentence is true after this change; "later in this same release" holds as long as the file exists to be edited. Empty frontmatter, so this prose reaches no CHANGELOG.
- **Other pending changesets** matching `TranslateFn|writeWarningToast|file-size-guard` on main: only `8165` and `9615-locale-count-ten.md`; 9615's claims (the docblock names `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` and restates no count) still hold in `file-size-guard.ts` at head. CI `Changeset Claim Re-read` green.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **CI on head `367e586e4`:** 43 check runs, 40 success, 3 skipped (matrix placeholders), 0 failure, 0 in progress at the final read; commit status success. Type Check, Lint, Test shards 1–8, Build & E2E, the four changeset checks, README Export Check, Doc Snippet Type Check and Governed Surface Queue Guard all success.
- **Mergeability:** `git merge-tree --write-tree` clean against main at `bc97f9247` and again at `1e946c96a`; 0 of 148 paths main moved since merge-base overlap the PR's 11; main's diff carries 0 `TranslateFn` lines. PR is draft, no auto-merge, head unchanged through this review.
- **Open PRs:** 11 others; none touches any of the 11 paths, `packages/i18n/`, `app-shell/src/providers/`, `file-size-guard` or the gate.
- **Governed surfaces:** none of the 11 paths is under `docs/adr`, `.claude`, `skills`, `AGENTS.md` or `CLAUDE.md`.
- **File surface vs. claim:** the Claim comment names i18n `src/`, `writeWarningToast.ts`, `file-size-guard.ts`, the gate, tests, one changeset. The PR also touches `saveAdvisoryToast.ts` (card-sanctioned: "can … point at the new home"), `metadataReadWarningToast.ts` (same pattern), `usePublishAllDrafts.ts` (an #8203 row; the body's "in this order's file surface" is not verifiable from the claim), `i18n/README.md` (commandment #2) and the 8165 changeset (truth maintenance). Not a breach I can show; the usePublishAllDrafts-yes, managedByEmptyState-no split is the inconsistency noted in ①.
- **Residue carrier:** #8203 closed `not_planned`; the PR's acceptance note names none. Nothing in this PR owes that work, but the published prose may not claim it done.
- **Discharge:** this record is FAIL, so `needs:contract-review` stays on the PR. The wording fix is one commit; that commit is a new head and needs its own same-shape record; every ① and ③ reading above carries over while the source diff is unchanged.

Reviewed-by: `session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`
